note: Client recomputes IL from r (price ratio) and the chosen range width using the same closed form as lib/concentrated.js. Only validated venues appear.

schema.r: price ratio over the window (exit price / entry price)
schema.fees: fee income over the window, percent of entry TVL
schema.adv: advertised APR percent -- what the DEX UI shows: most recent day fees, annualized. Has no price term, cannot be negative.
schema.realizedAprPct: precomputed realized return (fees + impermanent loss), annualized, at MODERATE (+/-2x) range. null if unmeasurable -- never a fabricated 0.
schema.gapPts: adv - realizedAprPct, at moderate range. Positive = advertised overstated reality.
schema.misleading: true if adv > 0 and realizedAprPct < 0, at moderate range. null if unmeasurable.

testVector.note: Real pool, real inputs, real output from THIS server at generation time. Implement the formula, run it on these inputs, and check you get realizedAprPct (within float rounding) before trusting your own math on any other pool.
testVector.formula: realizedReturnPct = fees + impermanentLossPct(r, rangeWidthX). IL closed form: let sa=sqrt(1/w), sb=sqrt(w); if r<=1/w: pos=(1/sa-1/sb)*r; elif r>=w: pos=sb-sa; else: pos=2*sqrt(r)-sa-r/sb; hodl=(1-sa)+(1-1/sb)*r; IL=(pos/hodl-1)*100. w=rangeWidthX (2 for moderate; 1e8 approximates full-range). realizedAprPct = realizedReturnPct/windowDays*365.

mcpServer: bin/mcp-server.js -- tools: find_pool, realized_return, audit_pools, explain_gap. find_pool(query) resolves a symbol like "WETH/USDC" to a poolId; no address needed.
